name: Sana Da Nang Beach Hotel
detail: The hotel is lovely and clean. The room was nice and the staff very helpful. The breakfast was ok but I wouldn't have paid for it if it hadn't been included in the price. The rooftop pool was nice but they should have towels available for guests. It's located very close to the beach which is great but there is a lot of building work going on around the hotel which isn't ideal. This is an expat area and relatively quiet compared to other parts of da nang. That suited us but may not be for everyone. A good price for the quality of hotel overall.

name: Centre Hotel
detail: Centre Hotel is such a nice hotel in Da Nang. Location is so near tourist attractions like the Dragon Bridge and Han River. Walking distance to the famous Han Market and lots of restaurants nearby. Staff are all friendly and accommodating. Our group of 5 stayed in one big room and it was really spacious and clean. Beddings make you sleep well and feel rested from a busy day tour. Breakfast were always satisfying and the lady in charge always greets us with a smile. Truly enjoyed our stay and will surely book again here. Thank you Centre!

name: The Blossom Resort Island Da Nang - Onsen Included
detail: I loved loved loved the resort and wish I could have stayed longer. My partner and I were only there for one night - and not even the full night because we left for the airport at 3am. I had already been staying in Hoi An and as I saw that they have a shuttle to Hoi An, I messaged the hotel and they kindly reserved a spot on the shuttle for me so my partner and I could get from Hoi An to the resort in Da Nang easily. Check in process was easy and smooth. Our bags were taken care of and we were given a 30 minute massage coupon + pho coupon for dinner. We ended up upgrading our massages to a full body 1 hour message and it was very relaxing. There's also an onsen but I didn't get to try that since I spent hours by the pool. They have comfy cabanas along the pool and it was never too too crowded. We ordered food to enjoy by the pool as well. It was beautiful watching the night sky take over and the Ferris wheel lighting up. The room itself was lovely and clean. AC worked amazing. They also had welcome fruit for us in the room :). Dinner is in the restaurant. The pho coupon allows you to have bottomless pho :) delicious! The staff were also very friendly and gentle. They always had a big smile on their face and made our experience at the resort a very pleasant one. :)

name: The Memory Danang Boutique
detail: This is the best hostel I’ve ever stayed in. It’s basically a hotel but for crazy cheap. All of the staff are amazing and so welcoming! I love how they give you refreshments throughout the day and that there was free fruit etc. The breakfast was okay (only two options). Only thing I would say is they didn’t top up the shower soap in the bathroom & I kept getting locked in the bathroom as the lock is stiff. Also it’s the not the best place to make friends if you’re a solo traveller as it’s quiet and not that sort of vibe. But still amazing, would definitely stay again. Thank you!

name: Palmier Hotel
detail: The hotel located in the central of Da Nang with a great river view. The room interior looks very nice and clean. Breakfast (buffet) is not much diversified with many dishes but the taste is fresh and good. Besides, that restaurant in 2nd floor is decorated with stylish garden theme, creating a very enjoyable moment for customers having fresh breakfast there in the morning. There is also a cafe in the Palmier complex (next to the hotel), with really pretty set up, suitable for an early morning coffee or a night-out drink with friend while admiring the river front view. However, the hotel should clearly state the size of the bed on their room info chart (for example 2x1.6m...) so customer can choose the room that have proper bed size (as I didn’t have that info so I had chosen a room with really small bed). And there should be a separate area for customers who smoke because of the quite heavy cigarettes smell on the 3rd floor all day make me feel a little bit suffocated. About the staff, they are very friendly and helpful, especially the doorman, except for the time the receptionist mistook my luggages with another customer’s luggages but luckily I found out. But after all, I would highly recommend this lovely hotel to any visitor who is looking for a comfortable stay with river view and great add-in services but for a very affordable price in Da Nang
